name: infiniteleverage
description: Infinite Leverage v2 — the AI-team product plugin. /il-project scaffolds a client project with a project-scoped 4-agent team; /il-adopt installs that team into an already-established repo; /il-doctor checks the setup; /il-memory-cleanup tidies a multi-account memory mess with the human in the loop. No hooks, no telemetry, no writes outside the project you scaffold.
